page.notes: The Hebrew throughout is set in small, worn type and the scan is faint, so most Hebrew forms are my best reading and are marked [?]. The vowel points and dagesh marks in particular are not certain. The left column ends "benefaci-" and the right column opens "et", which together form "benefaciet"; I have kept the line-end split as printed. Latin headwords and grammatical abbreviations are legible. The printed Hebrew catchword at the foot of the right column is only partly legible. The "V" is a gathering signature. Paragraph breaks are not applicable: this is a list of entries, so each printed line is one <l>.
